mechanism: Nitrofurantoin is renally cleared and may accumulate with loop diuretic-induced renal impairment; bumetanide increases ototoxicity risk and can worsen renal function, potentially reducing nitrofurantoin clearance.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, assess for signs of nitrofurantoin toxicity (peripheral neuropathy, ototoxicity), and consider alternative antibiotics if significant renal impairment develops.
